name: Hodge Podge
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical Hodgepodge / vegetable chowder portion sizes (roughly 2.5-3 cups finished soup per serving)
Total time is sum of explicit instruction steps (par-cook 5 min + blanch 1 min + melt/warm + bring to boil + simmer 10 min) plus estimated 5 min prep and 5 min miscellaneous; rounded conservatively
All vegetables, herbs, salt and pepper treated as gluten-free and free of the listed allergens
Milk, heavy cream and butter unambiguously introduce dairy
No eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy or sesame appear in ingredients
Recipe is lacto-vegetarian but not vegan due to explicit dairy ingredients
instructions:
First, cook your vegetables. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Par-cook carrots and potatoes for five minutes until carrots and potatoes are fork tender, then blanch the peas and beans for about a minute in the same pot. Strain vegetables and set aside.
In a heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, melt butter over medium heat, add vegetables, and cook to warm through.
Add milk and cream and bring the soup to a boil. Turn the heat down to low and season with salt and pepper.
Add dill and chives and let simmer for at least 10 minutes. Serve warm.
